architecture_overview: The system is a web-based task management application based on the PO acceptance criteria and SM sprint plan. It allows users to create, assign, track, and manage sprint tasks. The architecture follows a microservices approach, separating the frontend, backend API, and database layers. The frontend communicates with the backend REST API via secure HTTPS. The backend exposes endpoints for authentication, sprint management, and task tracking, and persists data in a relational database.

api_endpoints.description: Authenticate a user and return a JWT token.
Create a new sprint with a given name, start and end dates.
Retrieve all tasks for a specified sprint.

security_considerations: Use HTTPS for all client-server communications.
Store only hashed passwords using bcrypt.
Use JWTs for secure stateless authentication.
Implement role-based authorization for admins and team members.
Validate all input data to prevent SQL injection and XSS attacks.
Apply CORS policy restrictions and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints.

implementation_notes: Follow REST API design conventions and use Express for request routing. Use Sequelize ORM for PostgreSQL interaction. Implement unit tests using Jest for critical services and API endpoints. Use Docker for containerization and deploy via CI/CD pipeline. React frontend should consume the API through well-defined service classes and manage state via Redux Toolkit.
